entities.name: Tamiyo
entities.description: A Moonfolk planeswalker from Kamigawa and truth-seeker who collected stories, was compleated by Phyrexia, and was killed by the Wanderer.

entities.name: Phyrexian Tamiyo
entities.description: The compleated version of Tamiyo, the first Phyrexian planeswalker, whose sense of family was warped to serve Phyrexia.

entities.name: Tamiyo's memory scroll
entities.description: An iron-sealed scroll holding a story of Tamiyo with her pre-compleation personality, which preserved her memory after death.

entities.name: Genku
entities.description: Tamiyo's husband in Otawara.

entities.name: Nashi
entities.description: Tamiyo's adopted nezumi son who carried her memory scroll across the Multiverse.

entities.name: The Wanderer
entities.description: The Emperor of Kamigawa who kills Tamiyo.

entities.name: Kaito Shizuki
entities.description: A planeswalker who pursued Nashi, allied with Tamiyo, and later fought her.

entities.name: Tezzeret
entities.description: A planeswalker who took control of Tamiyo through the Reality Chip and kidnapped her to New Phyrexia.

entities.name: Jin-Gitaxias
entities.description: The praetor who compleated Tamiyo.

entities.name: Elesh Norn
entities.description: A praetor who sent Tamiyo to conquer Kamigawa and considered her a favorite.

entities.name: Jace Beleren
entities.description: A planeswalker who persuaded Tamiyo to face Avacyn and helped seal Emrakul.

entities.name: Emrakul
entities.description: The third Eldrazi titan, sealed at Thraben with Tamiyo's help.

entities.name: Avacyn
entities.description: An angel freed from the Helvault who went mad through Nahiri's machinations.

entities.name: Sorin Markov
entities.description: A planeswalker who destroyed his creation Avacyn.

entities.name: Gideon Jura
entities.description: A planeswalker who offered Tamiyo a place in the Gatewatch.

entities.name: Ajani Goldmane
entities.description: A planeswalker who visited Tamiyo after witnessing Elspeth's death.

entities.name: Gatewatch
entities.description: A team of planeswalkers who fought with Tamiyo at Thraben and Ravnica.

entities.name: Valgavoth
entities.description: The demon of Duskmourn who used Tamiyo's scroll to open doors to new planes.

entities.name: Kamigawa
entities.description: Tamiyo's home plane.

entities.name: Innistrad
entities.description: A plane where Tamiyo studied the silver moon.

entities.name: Duskmourn
entities.description: The plane to which Tamiyo's scroll was taken.

entities.name: Tamiyo's Story-Circle
entities.description: A small informal circle of planeswalkers who exchanged stories about the Multiverse.

entities.name: Reality Chip
entities.description: A chip that Tamiyo applied to the Emperor's hand and that Tezzeret used to control Tamiyo.

entities.name: Battle of Thraben
entities.description: The battle in which Emrakul was sealed.

entities.name: Nissa Revane
entities.description: A planeswalker who joined Tamiyo and Jace to seal Emrakul.

events.summary: As a young student, Tamiyo discovers a book from outside her plane and her spark ignites.
events.quote: The excitement she experienced thinking of the possibilities made her spark ignite

events.summary: On Innistrad Tamiyo studies the silver moon and Avacyn's release from the Helvault.
events.quote: Tamiyo excitedly began writing theories about the angel 's influence on the land, its creatures, and the moon.

events.summary: Ajani visits Tamiyo's home after witnessing Elspeth's death, and she lets him stay.
events.quote: She allowed him to stay until he was ready to move on.

events.summary: Jace persuades Tamiyo to confront the mad Avacyn; they nearly lose until Sorin destroys his creation.
events.quote: In the end, Sorin Markov showed up and destroyed his creation himself .

events.summary: Tamiyo joins the Gatewatch at the Battle of Thraben and helps seal Emrakul, using an iron-clad scroll.
events.quote: Tamiyo took out one of her iron-clad scrolls, and the spell succeeded in sealing the titan.

events.summary: Gideon offers Tamiyo a place in the Gatewatch but she declines, shaken.
events.quote: but Tamiyo declined, shaken by the experience.

events.summary: Tamiyo tells Jace that she had been possessed and the scroll's spell was Emrakul's design.
events.quote: She revealed that she had been possessed and that the scroll's spell had not been of her design, but of Emrakul.

events.summary: Tamiyo is trapped on Ravnica and is forced to fight Kefnet and the Eternals.
events.quote: she was forced to put her neutrality aside when confronted by the God -Eternal Kefnet .

events.summary: Tamiyo allies with Kaito against Tezzeret and Jin-Gitaxias.
events.quote: After learning that Kaito was really after Tezzeret and Jin-Gitaxias , she proposed an alliance.

events.summary: Tamiyo captures Tezzeret with a paralysis spell, but he later takes control of the Reality Chip and Tamiyo, kidnapping her to New Phyrexia.
events.quote: Tezzeret then used the Planar Bridge to kidnap Tamiyo and take her back to New Phyrexia.

events.summary: Jin-Gitaxias compleats Tamiyo, making her the first Phyrexian planeswalker.
events.quote: Tamiyo was compleated by Jin-Gitaxias, becoming the first Phyrexian planeswalker.

events.summary: Elesh Norn sends Tamiyo back to Kamigawa to conquer it; she corrupts Boseiju.
events.quote: Elesh Norn sent Tamiyo back to Towashi on Kamigawa to conquer her home plane.

events.summary: Tamiyo fights Kaito and the Wanderer kills her; her memory comforts Nashi.
events.quote: At the last possible moment, the Wanderer appeared and killed Tamiyo.

events.summary: Tamiyo's scroll is stolen and taken to Duskmourn, where Valgavoth's cultists strip her shade's memories; Nashi follows her voice and is trapped for three months.
events.quote: Nashi followed his mother's voice to the plane, getting trapped for three months before finally locating her.

events.summary: Tamiyo's shade begs Nashi to let her go, and he leaves the scroll in an Omenpath, freeing her memory in the Blind Eternities.
events.quote: he left the scroll in an artificial Omenpath , freeing her memory in the Blind Eternities .

relations.quote: She was the wife of Genku and the mother of Hiroku, Rumiyo, and Nashi .

relations.note: killed her at the last moment
relations.quote: the Wanderer appeared and killed Tamiyo.

relations.note: sent to conquer Kamigawa; Norn's favorite
relations.quote: Elesh Norn considered Tamiyo her favorite among them.

relations.note: took control of her and kidnapped her
relations.quote: allowing him to take control of the Reality Chip, and thus, Tamiyo.

relations.note: story scroll holds her pre-compleation memory
relations.quote: allowing her to persist in a fashion after her death.
